name: Kong Gateway
author: Netlens
description: Shows the routes a Kong Gateway (OSS or Enterprise, DB-less or with a database) publishes: host names, the upstream service address and port, protocols (http, https, tcp) and whether a route is enabled. Netlens ties every route to the device or container behind it, can keep an HTTPS check per site and can register the host names in DNS. Read-only: it only sends GET requests to the Admin API.

info.title: Reach the Admin API safely
info.text: Kong's Admin API can change everything and has no login in the open-source edition. Never publish it. Let it listen on a private address only (KONG_ADMIN_LISTEN=192.168.0.4:8001) and allow only Netlens to connect; in Kong Enterprise create an RBAC user with a read-only role and use its token below.

columns.label: Admin token
columns.help: Only for Kong Enterprise with RBAC (sent as Kong-Admin-Token).

columns.label: Kong host's own address
columns.help: The address of the machine Kong runs on, when the Admin API is reached by name or as 127.0.0.1. Site checks are sent to it.
